name: Extreme Picker
description: Picks your next Extreme Demon from the AREDL based on the ones you've beaten.

mode.name: What to recommend
mode.description:
<cy>Both</c>: new hardests and easier levels.
<cr>New hardest only</c>: only levels above your current hardest.
<cg>Easier levels only</c>: only levels below your current hardest.

max-jump.name: Max jump
max-jump.description: How many list places above your hardest a recommended level may be.

use-enjoyment.name: Prefer enjoyable levels
use-enjoyment.description: Gives a small boost to levels with a high enjoyment rating on the list.

include-legacy.name: Include legacy levels
include-legacy.description: Also recommend levels from the legacy list.

extra-completed.name: Extra beaten level IDs
extra-completed.description: Level IDs you've beaten that this save file doesn't know about (another account, lost data), separated by commas.
